method: Full Terms & Conditions PDF (30 pages, created 12 June 2026) saved by Geyer, read by hand

facts.text: The Company may 'disallow or block any Trader from participating in the program for any reason, in the Company's sole and absolute discretion'; it may act against conduct 'that we, at our sole discretion, regard as misaligned with our mission and values'; actions include cancelling trades and informing CTI, which may cancel 'all of your accounts or rewards'; any violation of the Terms forfeits 'their right to receive any rewards'.
If the Client 'acts in a manner that may damage the Company's good reputation', the Company may restrict access to all or some services.

Changes to fees and parameters, including the parameters for successful completion, 'do not affect the Services purchased before the change is notified'. (§17.3 still lets general Terms changes apply to existing contracts, with a right to reject by terminating.)
